name: Sparklight (Cable One)
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public support.sparklight.com articles only (no sign-in; the sign-in page redirects to a script-rendered Cable One SSO page, not read). The Sparklight Online Account uses a username and password. Quick Pay makes a one-time payment without signing in using the account number and ZIP code. Online, Auto Pay and IVR payments by credit card carry a 3% surcharge; debit cards and checking/savings are free (the engine applies the percentage to every card, debit included). Paying by phone with a representative costs $10. Auto Pay: Billing > Setup Auto Pay, choose or add a bank account, debit or credit card, accept the terms; pays by the due date (family timing kept); the app can turn Auto Pay on or off. The $10/month Auto Pay + Paperless discount is debit-card only (not modelled). Paperless billing is free and stops paper statements. No online cancel or payment-plan flow: billing support at 877-692-2253 (8-5 Mon-Fri) handles disconnects and late or missed payment options, so cancel_service and payment_arrangement are unsupported online. Disconnects: choose the end day, no partial-month credits; most plan changes now take effect next billing period (not modelled). Billing cycles can be changed by Billing Support. Late, reconnect, returned-check and termination fee amounts are not published. Mail: Sparklight, PO Box 78026, Phoenix, AZ 85062-8026.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment arrangements aren't set up online. To talk about options for a late or missed payment, call Billing Support at 877-692-2253, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday.

cancel_service.note: To disconnect Sparklight service, call 877-692-2253 (Billing Support, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday). You choose the day service ends; partial-month credits aren't offered.

notes: Paying by phone with a representative costs $10; the automated phone system has no convenience charge.
Late, reconnect, returned-check and termination fees may apply to past-due accounts.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay online in your Sparklight account, use Quick Pay with your account number and ZIP code without signing in, set up Auto Pay, call 877-692-2253 for the automated system or an agent, pay at a local bill-pay location such as MoneyGram, Western Union or CheckFreePay, or mail a check or money order to Sparklight, PO Box 78026, Phoenix, AZ 85062-8026 with your account number and bill stub.

Credit card payments made online, through Quick Pay, Auto Pay or the automated phone system carry a 3% surcharge. Debit cards and checking or savings accounts have no surcharge. Paying with a phone representative costs $10. Online and phone payments post within about a minute; mailed payments take 3-5 business days.

help.title: Set up Auto Pay
paragraphs: Sign in, open Billing and check your Auto Pay status. Select Setup Auto Pay, pick a saved payment method or Add Payment Method (bank account, debit card or credit card), enter your email if asked and accept the terms. A thank-you message confirms it.
Making a one-time payment doesn't turn on Auto Pay. In the MySparklight app you can turn Auto Pay on or off from Billing > Manage on the Auto Pay card.
steps: Sign in to your Sparklight account.
Choose or add a payment method and continue.

help.title: Disconnecting service
paragraphs: Call Billing Support at 877-692-2253 (8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday) to disconnect. You choose the day your service ends. Partial-month credits aren't offered, so you can keep service through the last day you've already been billed for.
Most plan changes now take effect at the start of your next billing period.
